rows.label: Mastery Rank 5

rows.label: Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment
rows.note: 100,000 cr, 10 Kavat Genetic Code, 60,000 Alloy Plate, 1 Argon Crystal

conditions: The 10 codes the segment uses are spent building it; they do not count toward the 10 an incubation needs.

rows.label: Adarza Kavat
rows.alt: use two Adarza Genetic Code Templates

conditions: Random Incubation cannot be steered to Adarza; a Smeeta means another 10 codes and another Power Core.
Two Adarza imprints make Adarza far likelier, not certain, and still cost the 10 codes and a core.
Incubation is 48 hours, or 24 with the Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment; rushing costs 15 platinum.
A built Power Core is a reusable 50,000-credit Market blueprint, 100,000 credits and 8 hours a build.
bonuses: Adarza imprints trade: a mature kavat can make three, 1.5 hours each. Empty templates come from a reusable 50,000-credit Market blueprint, 10,000 credits and 6 hours a build.
